sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B official model card, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Identifies the final BF16 RL/OPD release as the second MiniCPM5 model. Reports dense standard LlamaForCausalLM, 2,516,756,480 total and 1,981,982,720 non-embedding parameters, 42 layers, GQA 16 query/2 KV heads, and 131,072 context. Describes deep-thinking SFT, RL/OPD, XML tool calls and Apache-2.0 for model weights.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Selects LlamaForCausalLM/model_type llama: hidden 2048, intermediate 6144, 42 layers, 16 query heads, 2 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocabulary 130560, SiLU, max_position_embeddings 131072, rope_theta 5000000, rope_scaling null, untied embeddings and BF16. Declares Transformers 5.6.2; no quantization or custom-code configuration.

sources.title: Complete MiniCPM5-2B checkpoint index
sources.evidence: All 381 tensor names map to one shard, model-00000-of-00001.safetensors. Index total_size is 5,033,512,960 bytes. Every indexed tensor name was matched to its header and an enabled LlamaForCausalLM parameter.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B complete bounded safetensors header inspection
sources.evidence: Read only bytes 0-7 and 8-44135 with verified HTTP 206 Content-Range, totaling 44,136 bytes of a 5,033,557,096-byte file. The 44,128-byte header contains 381 BF16 parameter tensors. All names/shapes match the complete index and model reconstruction; contiguous byte offsets span 5,033,512,960 data bytes, exactly 2 bytes per element. Sum 2,516,756,480. No packed weights, scales, biases, extra tensors, aliases or stored buffers.

sources.title: Transformers 5.6.2 enabled Llama implementation
sources.evidence: Inspected the selected LlamaForCausalLM→LlamaModel→42 decoder layers: input embedding; bias-free GQA Q/K/V/O linear projections; three SiLU-gated MLP projections; two RMSNorm vectors per layer plus final norm; separate bias-free output head. RoPE inv_freq and original_inv_freq are nonpersistent computed buffers. No experts, routers, visual/audio modules, quantization modules or additional learned branches are selected.

sources.title: Transformers 5.6.2 LlamaConfig
sources.evidence: The selected class defaults attention_bias and mlp_bias to false, matching the absence of checkpoint bias tensors. Explicit checkpoint dimensions override generic Llama defaults. This is ordinary dense grouped-query causal attention, not MiniCPM4 InfLLM or MiniCPM-SALA attention.

sources.title: Transformers 5.6.2 weight-tying implementation
sources.evidence: get_expanded_tied_weights_keys returns an empty mapping when config.tie_word_embeddings is false. Thus LlamaForCausalLM generic tied-weight metadata does not tie this checkpoint; both separately stored 267,386,880-element matrices are counted once each.

sources.title: Contemporaneous MiniCPM5-2B README release entry
sources.evidence: README revision with September 5 Git commit timestamp already carries a future-dated 2026.09.07 MiniCPM5-2B release entry. This corroborates the intended September 7 launch; the commit timestamp itself is not a public-release date.

sources.title: ModelBest official news and technical-blog archive
sources.evidence: Rendered archive and embedded article metadata distinguish a July 19 WAIC unveiling from a September 8 open-source release announcement. The September article explicitly says ModelBest and OpenBMB open-sourced MiniCPM5-2B on September 8, with publishTime 2026-09-08T11:29:25Z. July excerpt names the model and event but does not establish public API or downloadable-weight availability.

sources.title: ModelBest MiniCPM5-2B press release
sources.evidence: Company-supplied release published September 9; text has a September 8 dateline but says the model was released September 9. Describes ModelBest/OpenBMB collaboration, released weights, tool calling and multi-step reasoning. This internal date conflict does not resolve earliest availability.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B native conversation template
sources.evidence: Serializes textual messages and reasoning_content, uses think delimiters, and provides explicit enable_thinking true/false branches. Supports tool definitions, XML function/parameter calls, tool_calls and tool responses. It contains no multimodal preprocessing pathway; complete selected model code and checkpoint likewise contain only the text language model.

sources.evidence: Read the original report linked as the model-card technical report. It covers MiniCPM4-0.5B/8 B, not MiniCPM5-2B; it contains no MiniCPM5 identifier. Its sparse-attention architecture and parameter figures are not transferred to this exact release.

name.note: Exact final release name; does not substitute Base, Midtrain, SFT, quantized or DSpark draft variants.

developer.note: Official OpenBMB namespace and repository; ModelBest press release confirms the collaboration. Preserve the catalog developer grouping OpenBMB.

family.note: Explicitly the second MiniCPM5-series model; normalized lowercase catalog family key.

release_date.note: Month precision: OpenBMB changelog and contemporaneous README saySeptember 7; ModelBest official archive says open-sourced September 8; its September 9 press release contains contradictory September 8/9 wording. HF creation/upload on September 6 do not prove when weights became public. July 19 was an unveiling in the accessed primary excerpt, not established public availability. September is verified; earliest day remains unresolved.

open_weights.note: Official public ungated BF16 checkpoint with accessible indexed tensor headers and Apache-licensed model weights.

license.note: Model-card frontmatter and License section explicitly apply Apache-2.0 to the model weights; canonical SPDX capitalization.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete released model count 2,516,756,480, independently matching all 381 indexed BF16 tensor shapes to the enabled code/config. V=130560,H=2048,I=6144,L=42,Q=16,K=2,D=128:2*V*H+H+L*(2*H+2*H*(Q+K)*D+3*H*I). Input embedding 267,386,880; untied output head 267,386,880; attention 396,361,728; MLP 1,585,446,912; all norms 174,080. No biases, quantization packing/scales, experts, adapters or stored nonparameter tensors. Computed nonpersistent RoPE buffers excluded. The published 1,981,982,720 non-embedding figure excludes both vocabulary matrices; it is not the full count.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined per-token active-parameter count in the exact card, current exact-model guide, selected implementation or accessible linked original reports. Dense architecture does not by itself justify equating active with total; non-embedding count is a component convention, not a reported active count. The JustRL II article body was inaccessible. Targeted exact-name searches found no later first-party active-count disclosure.

architecture.note: 42-layer decoder-only Transformer using standard LlamaForCausalLM, grouped-query causal attention 16 Q / 2 KV, dense SiLU-gated MLPs and RMSNorm. No experts or sparse/linear-attention branch in the selected code; no architectural transfer from MiniCPM4 or SALA.

context_window.note: Exact native context 131,072 tokens in the model specification and max_position_embeddings; rope_scaling is null. This is not a speculative extrapolation, DSpark setting or separately extended checkpoint.

modalities.note: Text-generation causal language model using token embeddings and vocabulary logits. Exhaustive checkpoint/module inspection finds no image/audio/video towers or output heads; native template consumes text messages. Tool calls remain structured text, not another modality.

reasoning.note: Exact release card describes deep-thinking SFT then RL/OPD; exact inference example enables thinking. Pinned native template supports reasoning_content and explicit think/no-think branches, rather than inheriting a provider default.

tool_call.note: Exact model-card Tool Calling section states XML function calls with the minicpm 5 parser; pinned template encodes tools, parameters, calls and responses. Confirms native structured tool-call support, not generic agent marketing.

description.value: Dense text language model with 2.517B parameters, native 131,072-token context, optional thinking, and XML-style tool calling.
description.note: Replaces nominal 2 B wording and broad deployment/agent claims with directly supported model specifications; rounded prose size refers to the complete 2.51675648 B total.

patch.description: Dense text language model with 2.517B parameters, native 131,072-token context, optional thinking, and XML-style tool calling.
patch.notes: Total parameters are 2,516,756,480 including separate input embeddings and output head; the card's 1,981,982,720 non-embedding count excludes both. Active parameters are not separately defined. Public-weight release is recorded at September 2026 precision: OpenBMB says September 7, ModelBest says September 8, and its press release conflicts internally on September 8/9. HF creation/upload on September 6 is not proof of public availability; July 19 was an earlier unveiling in the accessed official excerpt.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for exact final MiniCPM5-2B. Replaced nominal 2 B with exact complete 2.51675648 B using all 381 tensors in the one indexed shard plus enabled code/config, independently agreeing with the primary card. Added dense architecture and minicpm5 family; normalized Apache-2.0 and description. Native 131072 context, text modalities, thinking and tools confirmed. Active count remains undisclosed. Changed unsupported September 6 day precision to September 2026 because public-release sources conflict; documented earlier July unveiling and access limitations.
